Name: Simple Bundles and Joja Community Development
Author: wei2fun
Description:
[size=5][b]Simple Bundles and Joja Community Development[/b][/size]

[i]Complete Community Center bundles and Joja Community Development projects in a single day - no cooldowns, no grind. GMCM cheat toggles unlock the Bus, Minecarts, Bridge, Greenhouse and Pan without donating items or paying gold.[/i]

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Default mode:[/b] removes the vanilla 'one Joja development per day' limit - buy several or all 5 projects in a single day (each still completes overnight, with the vanilla repair cutscene).[/*]
[*][b]Cheat mode (GMCM):[/b] unlock any facility instantly, zero items donated, zero gold paid:
[list]
[*]Offering route: Crafts Room (bridge) / Pantry (greenhouse) / Fish Tank (pan) / Boiler Room (minecarts) / Vault (bus) / Bulletin Board (friendship) + [b]complete all rooms[/b][/*]
[*]Joja route: free membership (5,000g waived) + Minecarts / Pan / Bridge / Greenhouse / Bus + [b]complete all projects[/b][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Vanilla cutscenes:[/b] unlocks use the game's own repair cutscenes (Junimos / Joja crew) - sleep to watch, facilities work the next day.[/*]
[*][b]Mutually exclusive routes:[/b] switch freely before sleeping (the last selection wins); once you sleep, unlocks are [color=red]irreversible[/color].[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer:[/b] cheat unlocks are applied by the host.[/*]
[*][b]Languages:[/b] English (default) + Chinese (zh.json).[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+ (required)[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (recommended; without it, edit config.json instead)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]How to use[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install into [b]Mods/SimpleBundlesAndJoja[/b] and launch with SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Trigger the Community Center intro cutscene (day 5+ of Spring, Year 1 - enter town during the day). Cheat options stay disabled until then.[/*]
[*]Open the config menu (Mod Options → this mod) and check the options you want.[/*]
[*]Go to sleep - the repair cutscene plays, and the facilities are usable the next day.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Important notes[/b][/size]
[color=red][b]Cheat unlocks are irreversible once applied.[/b][/color] They write directly into your save. If you pick the wrong route, roll back your save - back it up first!

[list]
[*]Completing the Community Center via cheats closes JojaMart permanently (vanilla rule); completing all Joja projects converts JojaMart into the Joja Warehouse and rewards the Soda Machine.[/*]
[*]If you unlock several facilities the same day, only one repair cutscene plays per night (vanilla behavior) - the rest take effect silently.[/*]
[*]Works with remixed bundles (bundle contents differ, room flags are the same).[/*]
[*]Multiplayer: only the host's config applies cheats.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]FAQ[/b][/size]
[spoiler]
Before you sleep, checking any option of one route automatically unchecks the other route, so you can switch freely. The moment you sleep, the selected route is written to the save and cannot be changed.[/spoiler]
[spoiler]
No. The one-per-day limit is removed so you can buy multiple projects in one day, but each purchase still completes after sleeping, exactly like vanilla.[/spoiler]

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
Built with SMAPI, Generic Mod Config Menu and the Stardew Valley Wiki. Made with ♥ for the community.

[spoiler]
[size=4]简单收集包和 Joja 社区发展申请书[/size]
一天内完成社区中心收集包和 Joja 社区发展项目：默认模式移除原版『Joja 一天只能买一个』的限制；GMCM 作弊开关可免收集品、免金币直接解锁公共汽车、矿车、桥、暖房、淘金碗（含一键完成全部）。
路线互斥：未睡觉前可自由切换（以最后一次选择为准），睡觉生效后不可逆，请先备份存档。解锁走原版修复过场，次日设施可用。联机由主机端生效。[/spoiler]

[spoiler]
[b]v1.0.0[/b]
[list]
[*]Initial release: remove the Joja one-per-day limit; GMCM cheats for both routes (mutually exclusive, last selection wins before sleeping, irreversible after sleeping); vanilla repair cutscenes; multiplayer host support; EN + ZH translations.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
